note: `native/rust/crates/intent-cli/tests/surface_is_declared.rs` -- covers AC-06.13 -- status: red -- WRITTEN AND DRIVEN 2026-09-07 (cc). RED, and red on a NAMED RATCHET rather than on a defect anyone can fix here: the gate passes for every offered path except sixteen `<family> help` verbs, which are listed by name in HELP_NOT_DECLARED and reported on every run. AC-06.13 is NOT satisfied while that list is non-empty -- greening on a ratchet's existence certifies the process instead of the property, which is the ruling AT-06.8 already carries. THE REMEDY IS vc's ROW-SHAPE DECISION under 0217 and is not this file's to take. THE COUNT IS SIXTEEN, NOT NINE. 245dcdbe gave nine families an explicit help arm and 0217 records nine; clap generates a help subcommand on ANY command that has subcommands, so the population is every family with verbs. Derived by the instrument, not transcribed from the issue, which is the only reason the disagreement is visible. THE PREDICTED RED WAS DRIVEN BEFORE THE GREEN WAS TRUSTED, both ways: emptying the ratchet reddens naming all sixteen, and dropping a single row reddens on that one path alone -- so the gate fires on a non-ratcheted verb, which is the class 0217 names rather than this instance. THE DESIGN POINT WORTH CARRYING: a leaf resolves EITHER as an entry path/alias OR as a value on its parent's subcommand argument (the daemon pattern). Reading entry paths alone reports 37 undeclared of which 21 are working commands -- claude rules/skills/subagents/ws, agents template and surface all take that shape. Binds env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_intent") as the row always required; hidden subcommands are out of reach by construction and retired_commands holds that ground. GREEN 2026-09-09 (cc), AND THE RATCHET EMPTIED BY THE TABLE LEARNING TO SAY THE THING RATHER THAN BY THE CHECK BEING WAIVED. HELP_NOT_DECLARED named sixteen `<family> help` spellings the binary offers and no row declared; this note said AC-06.13 stays unsatisfied while that list is non-empty, and it did. vc ruled `0217` on 2026-09-09 under hv's pen: those rows are DERIVED -- not hand-authored, because sixteen identical rows describing one uniform behaviour is the transcription AC-17.15 forbids, and not exempted, because an exemption puts the verb outside this row's population by construction, which is the defect 0217 names reintroduced one level in. So `declared()` grew a THIRD form asking `dispatch::family_builds_out_its_verbs`, the one home for the spine's own predicate: the spine calls it to BUILD a family out and `declared()` calls it to DECLARE the `help` that building produces. The list is gone rather than emptied by hand. CENSUS AT GREEN: 175 spellings offered, 4 of them aliases, 0 undeclared. ALIASES ARE NOW IN THE POPULATION AND THAT IS A RULING -- inclusion reds an alias the binary offers and the table does not declare, where exclusion could not see one; `lang rm` resolves through `lang remove` and is pinned so the check cannot cry wolf on its own first run. THE PREDICATE'S FIRST NAME WAS A DEFECT, FOUND BY AN OVER-KILL MUTATION: `family_gets_synthetic_help` is what the caller wanted to ask and is narrower than what the function gates -- forcing it false also deleted `claude skills install`, because the same spine block attaches family flags and positionals, expands slot `values` into leaves and sets `subcommand_required`. Recorded as over-kill rather than a clean kill. AND THE STRONGEST-LOOKING ARM WAS DELETED AS VACUOUS: asserting the derivation equals what the binary offers proves nothing, because the spine ADDS through the function the check reads, so a mutated predicate moved both sides and every arm stayed green. Replaced by a floor that is still falsifiable. ONE HOME: a second instrument for this row was written on 2026-09-08 and is deleted at `ab10add3e`; this file is the one AT-06.13 names and `intent at` has no verb to retarget a row's file. DRIVEN: 4/4 here, 530/530 across the crate; an undeclared subcommand planted in the spine reds the gate naming it.
